document_metadata.document_type: Policy Guidelines / Terms of Service Auxiliary

jurisdiction_trap.details: Governed by Google's master Terms of Service, which mandates Santa Clara County, California, USA as the exclusive venue, creating an insurmountable financial and logistical barrier for non-US or low-income users.

extracted_clauses.exact_quote: These are well-known issues for large language models, and while we continue to work to mitigate these challenges, Gemini may sometimes produce content that violates our guidelines, reflects limited viewpoints or includes overgeneralizations, especially in response to challenging prompts.
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: We know our AI generates toxic, inaccurate, and harmful content. By calling this a 'well-known issue' of probabilistic models, we legally wash our hands of any real-world damage, defamation, or financial ruin our software causes you.

extracted_clauses.exact_quote: As we learn more about how people use the Gemini app and find it most helpful, we will update these guidelines.
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: We reserve the right to rewrite the rules of engagement at any moment without prior notice. Your continued use of the service constitutes automatic consent to whatever new restrictions or liabilities we invent.

extracted_clauses.violation_type: Vague Community Guidelines & Pretextual Ban Loophole
extracted_clauses.exact_quote: Of course, context matters. We consider multiple factors when evaluating outputs, including educational, documentary, artistic, or scientific applications... Gemini should not generate outputs that describe or depict sensational, shocking, or gratuitous violence...
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: We use highly subjective, undefined terms like 'sensational' or 'shocking' to police your prompts. We reserve absolute, un-appealable discretion to ban your account or censor your data under the guise of 'contextual evaluation'.

strategic_recommendation: AIR-GAP. Do not feed proprietary, sensitive, or legally protected data into Gemini. The platform disclaims all liability for its own algorithmic failures while reserving the right to unilaterally modify rules and harvest user interactions.
